notes: Mirage clock gains the Spoken arrangement from the CEO drawings: a quiet lead-in over the fact ("Today is" over the day, "The current time is" over the time); the lead-in goes first when the card is too short for both.

The shared row gives way by TYPE first: the reading steps down (never below its label or the floor) before the sub-label goes, then again before the glyph goes - his one-row sensor card carries a glyph under every label.

Mirage glyph family gains the parts a reading belongs to (chip, graphics card, drive, memory, battery) on the same 24 grid and weight; the sensor row names its columns with them, and a glyph row nothing can fill is not reserved.
